name: Sichuan Injet Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Injet Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of industrial power supply equipment and new energy vehicle charging products in China. The company offers power controllers; general AC/DC power supply products; PDB series and PDA air-cooled programmable power supply products; RF and sputtering power supply products; induction power products; high-voltage DC power module and supply products, solid state modulators, and microwave power products; and electric fusion welding machines, harmonic control products, motor soft starters, and complete control systems.
